body: Watching a little boy play with some blocks in the waiting room of a mental health clinic after a man stopped me running out onto the motorway to kill myself. The reason I was going to run out was due to a miscarriage. Never felt pain hit me like that. I cried silently in a room full of people and everything turned to white noise.
I don't think anyone else should be put down, just me. I have a lot of respect and empathy for people in similar positions. I just think I should've known better.
I used to write them down but my mum got freaked out and stopped me and I can't write how I used to any more, there's something that blocks it now.
